newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico confirms winning bid for Yucatan pipeline.
newsitem.headline: Mexico confirms winning bid for Yucatan pipeline.

text.p: Mexico's Federal Electricity Commission (CFE) confirmed on Thursday the consortium of Transcanada Pipelines Limited, Mexico's Gutsa Construcciones, and U.S. Intergen won the bid to build a Yucatan state pipeline.
The pipeline will supply the Merida III power plant with natural gas and is expected run more than 500 km (310 miles) and carry about 10.4 million cubic feet per day of natural gas.
CFE spokesman Jose Luis Uribe Ortega told Reuters that the companies had won the bid and said more information would be provided later in the day.
The consortium beat out four other bidding groups.
